name: Tatsunami Ittousai
source:
Ittousai's an old acquaintance of Yo, Jin and Bo and their rival. He's also hired as a bodyguard but is seen by the others as nothing but an assassin or a sociopath. 
He's a ruthless mercenary whose life work and joy is killing, and has a body covered with scars from old sword wounds.
